description: Get the latest Base block with its age in seconds, base fee and gas used. The latest Base block: number, hash, timestamp, age in seconds (so you know the node is not lagging), base fee, gas used. Public RPC, no key. Query: none. — $0.005000/call, paid per request via x402 (USDC). Use when asked: "latest block number on base", "current block height", "what block is base at".
name: chain_block
